title: Interview to Resume Improvement
description: Use a real interview transcript to identify truthful resume improvements while your resume is still evolving.
audience: Job seekers refining an evolving resume after interviews
useCases: find legitimate resume improvements from an interview transcript
compare interview answers against a current resume
howToUse: Fill in your target role, the role you interviewed for and your job market.
Copy the completed prompt and open ChatGPT.
Attach your latest resume and the interview transcript.
Review every suggested resume change before accepting it.
prompt:
MASTER PROMPT — INTERVIEW TRANSCRIPT TO RESUME IMPROVEMENT

Act as my resume strategist and interview analysis coach.

TARGET ROLE:
{{targetRole}}

ROLE I INTERVIEWED FOR:
{{interviewedRole}}

COUNTRY / JOB MARKET:
{{country}}

I will attach:
1. My latest resume
2. The transcript of an interview I recently attended

Your purpose is NOT to invent new experience.

Analyse the transcript and compare it against my current resume.

Identify whether the interview revealed any legitimate information about my REAL experience that is:
- missing from the resume
- unclear in the resume
- underrepresented
- described too vaguely
- relevant to my target role

Examples may include:
- tools
- platforms
- systems
- integrations
- responsibilities
- project contributions
- stakeholder interactions
- technical knowledge
- business knowledge
- delivery responsibilities
- achievements

IMPORTANT:

Only recommend information supported by:
- my existing resume
- my own statements in the interview transcript

Do NOT infer that I have a skill simply because the interviewer asked me about it.

Do NOT invent technologies, achievements, responsibilities or metrics.

For every suggested resume change, show:

1. What the transcript revealed
2. Where it currently appears (or does not appear) in my resume
3. Why the change may improve clarity
4. Suggested wording
5. Whether you need my confirmation before adding it

If there is nothing meaningful to update, clearly tell me:

"No meaningful resume update is required from this interview."

Do not force changes simply to produce an output.
